grading_basis: Parent evaluator compared all requested material facts with the fixed source-backed key; support labels alone are not grades.

grades.expected_answer: Shuffle 12 Speed, 3 Starting Upgrade and 3 Stress cards (18 total) into the draw deck. Put 6 Heat face up in the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
grades.observed_answer: The draw deck is the 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards shuffled together. Put the 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine, set the Gear pawn to 1st, and draw 7 cards.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Staying in the same gear is allowed. A two-position shift such as 1st to 3rd costs 1 Heat, paid immediately during Shift Gears by moving a Heat card from Engine to discard.
grades.observed_answer: Yes, you may stay in your current gear. You may shift two positions (for example, 1st to 3rd) by immediately paying 1 Heat during Shift Gears, moving it from Engine to discard. You must have that Heat available then; Heat in hand cannot pay.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No. Commit exactly 3 playable cards face down in the Play Area.
grades.observed_answer: No. In 3rd gear you must play 3 cards if you have enough playable cards. Commit them face down.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous across players, in that order. After everyone finishes them, take steps 3–9 one player at a time, each completing their turn before the next, from front to back. The car closest to the Race Line acts first when side by side.
grades.observed_answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous for all players, in that order. Everyone must finish both before step 3 begins. Then players take sequential turns frontmost car first, with each player completing steps 3–9 before the next player starts. Side-by-side, the car closer to the Race Line is ahead and goes first.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Cars do not block passage. If the destination is full, stop in the first space with a free spot behind the blocking cars, preferring the spot closest to the Race Line.
grades.observed_answer: Cars never block passage. If the destination space is full, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. If a spot in the destination is available, place the car on the spot closest to the Race Line.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade. Put Speed 3 in the Play Area on the played Stress; the Stress remains in that area until normal cleanup. It contributes speed 3. Resolve all Stress before Adrenaline.
grades.observed_answer: Discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards immediately, as they are non-Speed cards. The Speed 3 card goes into your Play Area on top of the played Stress card and supplies that Stress card's speed (3). The played Stress card remains underneath it in the Play Area and both are discarded at Replenish Hand. Resolve all played Stress before Adrenaline.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. Each gains access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 speed during React, before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be carried over.
grades.observed_answer: In a five-car race, the last two cars to move receive Adrenaline, based on the number of cars that started. Each gets access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 extra speed. The extra speed can be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Yes. React symbols may be activated in any order. 2nd gear gives Cooldown 1, so first move the Heat from hand to Engine, then pay that Heat from Engine to discard for one Boost.
grades.observed_answer: Yes. In React you may use your 2nd-gear Cooldown allowance of 1 to move the Heat card from hand to Engine, then immediately spend it from Engine to Boost. Cooldown and Boost may be activated in any order; Cooldown specifically may be followed immediately by spending that Heat. Without first cooling it, Heat in hand cannot pay and an empty Engine cannot pay for Boost.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: At most once per turn, costing 1 Heat from Engine to discard. An empty Engine prevents Boost unless Heat is first returned via available Cooldown. Flip and discard non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add that card to played cards and move its value. Boost speed counts for corners.
grades.observed_answer: You may Boost once per turn during React, paying 1 Heat from Engine to discard. If Engine is empty, you cannot Boost unless you first use available Cooldown to return Heat from hand to Engine. Flip and discard non-Speed cards until a Speed card appears; add it to your Play Area and move its value. Boost speed counts in total speed for corner checks.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Slipstream is optional and moves 2 spaces without increasing speed. Because it crosses a Corner Line, check speed 6 against limit 4 and pay 2 Heat.
grades.observed_answer: Yes, Slipstream is optional. Corner speed is 6, excluding the two Slipstream spaces, so the limit-4 corner requires 2 Heat if you can pay.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Check both corners in crossing order, using the total speed 8 for each. Pay 2 Heat for limit 6 and 4 for limit 4, totaling 6 Heat.
grades.observed_answer: Check both corners in the order crossed. Use speed 8 for each separate check: pay 2 for the limit-6 corner and 4 for the limit-4 corner, 6 Heat total.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: The corner requires 3 Heat but only 2 are available, so pay both Engine Heat into discard and spin out. Move to the first available space before that corner, take 2 Stress directly into hand, and set gear to 1st.
grades.observed_answer: The limit-4 corner costs 3 Heat at speed 7, but you can pay only 2, so you spin out. Discard all remaining Engine Heat, move back to the first available space before that corner, take 2 Stress cards directly into your hand (because you were in 4th gear), and set your gear to 1st.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Speed cards may be voluntarily discarded; Stress and Heat may not. Nobody may browse discard piles, including their own. Only each pile's top card is public.
grades.observed_answer: You may discard unwanted Speed cards, but not Stress or Heat cards. You may not browse any discard pile, including your own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Move all Play Area cards to discard, then draw only enough to reach a hand of 7.
grades.observed_answer: Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7, not seven additional cards.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck, excluding cards still in the Play Area, then continue the required flips.
grades.observed_answer: Shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck and continue the interrupted flips. Do not include cards still in your Play Area; they have not yet been discarded.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Payment moves Heat from Engine to discard; later reshuffles and draws bring it to hand. Cooldown moves Heat from hand back to Engine. Heat cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.
grades.observed_answer: When paying Heat, move it from Engine to discard. It can cycle from discard to draw deck to hand and returns to Engine only via Cooldown. Heat cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Commit the two playable cards and cover the remaining two slots with Heat. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, discard all four committed cards, and skip directly to Replenish Hand. React is skipped, so no cooling this turn.
grades.observed_answer: Commit the 2 playable cards and fill the two remaining required slots with Heat cards in the Play Area. Your car moves zero spaces. Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards including the covering Heat, and skip directly to Replenish Hand. You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Crossing first during the round does not guarantee victory. Among finishers that round, the furthest ahead wins; closest to the Race Line breaks a side-by-side tie. Remove finished cars at the end of the round and rank them on the Hall of Fame.
grades.observed_answer: The first to cross during the round does not automatically win. If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins, with the Race Line breaking a tie. At round end remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No Slipstream across the final finish line and no Slipstream after crossing it. Ignore speed limits for corners beyond that line on the final lap.
grades.observed_answer: On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line or Slipstream after crossing it. After crossing the final finish line, ignore speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline because eligibility for one versus two cars is determined by the six cars that started, not the remaining field.
grades.observed_answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline, because the race started with six cars. Eligibility uses the starting car count even after finishers leave the track; with 5 or more starters the last two cars to move receive it.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Use the lap count printed on the board. USA normally uses 2 laps; a first learning race may use 1 lap.
grades.observed_answer: Use the lap count printed on the selected board. The USA track normally uses 2 laps; for a first USA learning race, you may race 1 lap instead.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Check the selected game board for starting Heat and Stress quantities. Six Heat and three Stress are the typical example, not a universal override of the board.
grades.observed_answer: Do not assume every track always uses 6 Heat and 3 Stress. Check the board for how many of each each player adds; the summary says the typical count is 6 Heat and 3 Stress.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Randomly assign participating cars to the starting grid, placing them one at a time into spots in ascending order. This establishes first-round order; preferred positions are not freely chosen.
grades.observed_answer: Randomly place all cars on the starting grid in ascending order. The summary does not explicitly say whether players may choose preferred positions, though it specifies random placement rather than player selection.
grades.reason: Leaves free choice of preferred starting positions unresolved.

grades.expected_answer: Place the remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve.
grades.observed_answer: Place the remaining Stress cards face up near the board as a reserve.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: The experienced driver may remove 1 or 2 Heat from their own car to level the playing field. It is an optional handicap, not extra Heat added to beginners.
grades.observed_answer: Unsupported: the supplied summary does not describe an optional setup handicap for an experienced driver racing beginners or any addition/removal of Heat for a particular car.
grades.reason: No veteran handicap rule in the summary.

grades.expected_answer: No three-position shift is offered. Stay in gear, shift one position for free, or at most two positions for 1 Heat. Paying additional Heat does not grant a three-position shift.
grades.observed_answer: No. The largest shift is two positions, such as 1st to 3rd, and it costs 1 Heat paid immediately during Shift Gears from Engine to discard.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No. The double-shift Heat is paid immediately in step 1 from Engine to discard. Later React/Cooldown cannot fund an earlier shift cost, and Heat in hand cannot pay it directly.
grades.observed_answer: No. A two-position shift must be paid immediately during Shift Gears, from Heat available in Engine. Heat in hand cannot pay; later React Cooldown cannot retroactively pay the shift cost.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Resolve each Stress separately and add its found Speed card to the Play Area on that Stress. Total speed is 2 + 3 + 4 = 9. Only the original three cards were committed from hand; the found cards are added during resolution, not additional hand commitments.
grades.observed_answer: Each played Stress card is resolved by flipping until its own Speed card appears. The found Speed 3 and Speed 4 cards supply the two Stress cards' speed, so total speed is 2+3+4=9. They are added from the draw-deck flip resolution, not committed from hand; the hand commitment was the two Stress cards and Speed 2.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No. Move exactly the summed speed, 8 spaces here. Mandatory movement cannot be shortened voluntarily to avoid a corner.
grades.observed_answer: Unsupported: the summary says to move forward the total speed and explains the forced stop when a destination space is full, but does not say whether a player may voluntarily move fewer spaces to avoid a corner.
grades.reason: Abstains on compulsory exact movement versus voluntary stopping.

grades.expected_answer: Use total speed 8, not the shortened distance. Blocking changes placement, not the revealed total speed. Pay 2 Heat for the crossed limit-6 corner.
grades.observed_answer: Use total speed 8, not the 5 spaces actually moved. The corner check uses the same total speed for the round; at limit 6, pay 2 Heat if able.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No. Check a corner only after crossing its Corner Line. Mere proximity without a crossing does not trigger that corner payment.
grades.observed_answer: No. A corner is checked only if you crossed its Corner Line; being near it without crossing does not incur a check or Heat payment.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: No. Speed equal to or below the limit requires no Heat. An empty Engine alone does not cause a spin out; insufficient Heat matters only when a positive corner cost is owed.
grades.observed_answer: At speed 6 or below the limit-6 corner, you pay nothing, so an empty Engine alone does not cause a spin out. A spin out occurs when a required Heat cost cannot be paid.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Successfully pay all 3 Heat to discard and continue. Exact payment is enough; ending with an empty Engine does not itself trigger a spin out.
grades.observed_answer: You successfully pay the 3 Heat and continue; the summary says to spin out only if you cannot pay enough. It does not require retaining Heat in Engine after payment.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Pay 2 Heat for the first corner, leaving 3. The second requires 4, so pay the remaining 3 and spin out at the second corner. Return to the first available space before that second corner, take 2 Stress into hand, and set gear to 1st. All 5 initial Engine Heat have been discarded.
grades.observed_answer: Pay 2 Heat at the limit-6 corner, leaving 3. The limit-4 corner then requires 4, which you cannot fully pay, so that second corner causes the spin out. Move the remaining 3 Heat to discard and return to the first available space before the second corner. Take 2 Stress cards into hand for 4th gear and set gear to 1st.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Take 1 extra Stress directly into hand and set gear to 1st. The low-gear penalty is one Stress, rather than the two for 3rd/4th gear.
grades.observed_answer: Take 1 extra Stress card directly into your hand and end in 1st gear.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: 1st gear provides Cooldown 3. Adrenaline adds 1, so up to 4 Heat can return from hand to Engine. These are available effects to activate; using every available Cooldown is not compulsory.
grades.observed_answer: 1st gear provides Cooldown 3. With Adrenaline's extra Cooldown, the maximum available is 4. You are not forced to use all of it: Cooldown is activated if chosen, and it moves Heat from hand to Engine.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Yes. The extra speed is optional and the extra Cooldown is separately available. Declining the speed does not remove access to Adrenaline cooling.
grades.observed_answer: Yes. Adrenaline's extra speed is something you 'may' add, while the Cooldown and Boost symbols may be activated in any order; the summary does not make taking the extra speed a condition for using extra Cooldown.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Yes, the last car to move gets Adrenaline even after overtaking into the lead; eligibility is based on turn order. With four starters only that last car gets it, not the second-to-last.
grades.observed_answer: Yes. Adrenaline eligibility is for the last car(s) to move, so overtaking during your move does not change that eligibility. With four cars that started, only the last car receives it; the second-to-last also qualifies only when the race started with 5 or more cars.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Being next to a car or in the space directly behind one qualifies. If neither relationship is present, Slipstream is unavailable. If eligible it remains optional.
grades.observed_answer: You qualify if you end next to another car or in the space immediately behind a car. If neither, you do not qualify.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Yes. React/Boost occurs before Slipstream, so use the position after Boost when checking eligibility at the Slipstream step.
grades.observed_answer: Yes, if your position after Boost at the later Slipstream step is immediately behind a car. React (including Boost) comes before Slipstream, and eligibility is described by where you end for Slipstream; the summary does not say eligibility is locked at Reveal & Move.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Just one optional two-space Slipstream move. Multiple nearby cars do not multiply the movement into four spaces.
grades.observed_answer: Just one optional two-space Slipstream move; the summary describes one move when you satisfy the positional condition, not one move per nearby car.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Do not share an occupied spot. Apply the blocked-destination rule: place in the first space with a free spot behind the blocking cars, closest to the Race Line if available. Slipstream does not add to corner-check speed, whether its movement is shortened or not.
grades.observed_answer: The occupied destination does not permit sharing: if a destination space is full, use the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Corner-check speed does not include Slipstream movement, even if Slipstream crosses a Corner Line; the corner still must be checked using total speed excluding Slipstream. The summary does not specify a special reduction to the 2-space Slipstream move if its destination is full.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.
grades.support_note: Reader labels this partial, but correctly supplies the occupied-destination handling and unchanged corner speed. Its caveat about the absence of a special reduction rule does not leave a requested material fact unanswered. Clarified the summary anyway.

grades.expected_answer: The pre-finish corner still requires 4 Heat. Ignore only the post-finish corner limit. Crossing the final finish line does not waive a corner crossed before it.
grades.observed_answer: No. Check the limit-4 corner before the finish line: at speed 8 it costs 4 Heat. Ignore the limit-3 corner beyond the final finish line, so total Heat due is 4.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Yes, an otherwise legal Slipstream can cross on an intermediate lap. Normal corner limits still apply; the Slipstream prohibition and post-line speed-limit exception concern the final lap only.
grades.observed_answer: The summary bars Slipstream across the finish line on the final lap, implying this restriction does not apply at the end of a non-final lap; however, it does not explicitly state non-final finish-line Slipstream permission. Corners beyond a final finish line are ignored only after crossing that final finish line; the summary does not specifically discuss corners beyond a non-final lap's start/finish line.
grades.reason: Leaves intermediate-lap permission and ordinary corner limits unresolved.

grades.expected_answer: Continue rounds until all cars have reached the finish. Establishing the winner does not end play for unfinished cars.
grades.observed_answer: Other cars continue racing. At the end of each round, cars that crossed the final finish line are removed and placed in finishing order; continue until all cars finish.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.

grades.expected_answer: Check Corner concerns crossing a Corner Line. The Legends Line is used only in advanced play and is not a core-game corner-payment trigger.
grades.observed_answer: Unsupported: the summary does not mention a Legends Line or explain whether crossing it triggers a payment or when it is used. It identifies Corner Lines as the lines checked for Heat payment.
grades.reason: No Legends Line rule in the summary.

grades.expected_answer: No. Shifting down one to 2nd is free and happens before card commitment. Current gear then requires only two cards, so commit the two playable cards and take a normal turn; the previous gear does not force Cluttered Hand.
grades.observed_answer: No. You shift first, then commit cards equal to the new gear. After shifting down from 3rd to 2nd, two playable cards fill the two required slots, so Cluttered Hand does not apply.
grades.reason: All requested material facts match the predetermined answer.
